title: First Sitting of 2nd Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/1/2/2025).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of Law No. 20/2021 (Foreign Service Act) to appoint a non-resident ambassador of the Maldives to Nepal is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of Law No. 20/2021 (Foreign Service Act) to appoint a non-resident ambassador of the Maldives to Ireland is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of Law No. 20/2021 (Foreign Service Act) to appoint a non-resident ambassador of the Maldives to Ukraine is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominations under Article 148(a) of the Constitution for appointment as Justices of the Supreme Court are sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Preliminary debate on the bill submitted on behalf of the government by Dhaandhoo MP Mohamed Fazeel to amend Law No. 2/2012 (Maldives Civil Aviation Authority Act).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The first sitting of the session sent three non-resident ambassador nominations and the Supreme Court justice nominations to committees, and began the preliminary debate on amending the Civil Aviation Authority Act.
